label: thm:brauer-character-in-cyclotomic
title: Character values of finite groups lie in cyclotomic fields, II
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite group.  Then there exists a ring homomorphism
  \[
    \varphi : \mathrm{CyclotomicField}\,(\mathrm{Monoid.exponent}\,G)\,\mathbb{Q} \;\longrightarrow\; \mathbb{C}
  \]
  with the following property: for every complex vector space $V$, i.e.\ \verb|[AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]|, and every representation
  \[
    \rho : G \to^\ast (V \to_{\ell[\mathbb{C}]} V)
  \]
  (that is, \verb|ρ : G →* (V →ₗ[ℂ] V)|), and every $g \in G$,
  \[
    \mathrm{tr}_{\mathbb{C}}\,V\,(\rho g) \in \varphi.\mathrm{range}.
  \]
proof: Set $n = $ \verb|Monoid.exponent G|; since $G$ is finite, $n \neq 0$ by \verb|Monoid.exponent_ne_zero_of_finite|.  Obtain $\varphi$ from Lemma~\ref{lem:cyclotomic-embed} (instantiated at this $n$).  For any $V$, $\rho$, $g$, Lemma~\ref{lem:trace-mem-range} provides the conclusion.
